retrievalProfile.description: A portrait-centric layout featuring a subject leaning against urban architecture with wide, horizontally-stretched typography positioned in the upper third.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close portrait of a man in a black shirt and patterned kufi cap, leaning against a metal railing in an urban setting. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to blur the background greenery and street, while the top of the frame features a red gradient bar containing wide, futuristic sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's diagonal lean balances the vertical lines of the railing
Horizontal text blocks anchor the top edge of the frame
Warm skin tones and gold cap contrast with the cool-toned blurred background
Red header bar provides a distinct separation for primary branding

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, leaning from right to left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the gold patterned cap serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the high-contrast text at the top, move down to the face, and follow the arm along the railing.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left side of the frame is open with a blurred bokeh effect of trees and a street.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and browns in the subject's clothing and skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted greens and blues in the blurred background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red in the top gradient bar and gold in the headwear and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the header and cap; low saturation and high value in the background bokeh.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' has a shallow middle vertex
The 'G' has a simple bar terminal
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic font family with varying weights, widths, and colors to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal red gradient bar at the top
Drop shadows on text for legibility against the background

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century modern, wide geometric aesthetic.
Provides the square-ish, technical feel of the primary text.
Offers the clean, wide proportions seen in the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a black shirt and a gold-patterned kufi cap, leaning on a brown metal railing. The background should be a soft-focus urban street with green trees and a blue-grey road. Leave the top 15% of the image for a red-to-transparent gradient bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-wide white sans-serif text centered in the red bar. Below it, add smaller gold-colored sans-serif text with wide letter spacing and a thin black outline.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text horizontally stretched?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to create depth?
Is the red bar present at the top edge?
Is the subject leaning on a railing?

adjustableVariables: Color of the top gradient bar
Specific urban background (e.g., brick wall vs. park)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Any brand logos or specific album titles

mustAchieve: Clear separation between text and subject

postGenerationChecks: Red header bar is semi-transparent or gradient
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Ultra-Wide Header + Red Gradient Overlay + Shallow Depth of Field
